description: Backend API (apps/api): NestJS modular app with Prisma schema modeling the FULL domain (Product + all other entities/enums from docs/diagrams/class-domain.puml), a seed script with >=6 realistic coffee products, and a CatalogModule exposing GET /products (list) and GET /products/:id (404 if missing), with Jest unit tests that mock Prisma (no live DB). Depends on FEAT-001 (workspace root). Build and tests MUST pass with NO live Postgres — only `prisma generate` runs at build.
steps: Scaffold apps/api NestJS app: apps/api/package.json (scripts: "lint": eslint src, "test": "jest", "build": "prisma generate && nest build", "start:dev": "nest start --watch", and a "prisma" seed config pointing at prisma/seed.ts via ts-node), apps/api/tsconfig.json, apps/api/tsconfig.build.json, apps/api/nest-cli.json, apps/api/.eslintrc.js, apps/api/jest config (in package.json or jest.config). Pin current stable NestJS 10/11, Prisma 5/6, class-validator, class-transformer, ts-node/ts-jest.

Create apps/api/src/main.ts: bootstrap NestFactory(AppModule), read PORT (default 3001), enable CORS with origin from CORS_ORIGIN (default http://localhost:3000), apply global ValidationPipe({ whitelist: true, transform: true }). Create apps/api/src/app.module.ts importing PrismaModule and CatalogModule.

Create apps/api/prisma/schema.prisma: datasource db postgresql url env("DATABASE_URL"); generator client prisma-client-js. Define enums Role, OrderStatus, PaymentStatus, PaymentMethod, PromotionType and models User, Product, Order, OrderItem, Payment, Promotion, LoyaltyTransaction exactly per docs/diagrams/class-domain.puml. Product fields: id String @id @default(cuid()), code String @unique, name String, description String, basePrice Decimal, imageUrl String, category String, isAvailable Boolean @default(true), stockQuantity Int @default(0), createdAt DateTime @default(now()). Add relations/multiplicities consistent with the diagram.
Create apps/api/src/prisma/prisma.service.ts (extends PrismaClient, onModuleInit connects) and apps/api/src/prisma/prisma.module.ts (@Global, provides+exports PrismaService).

Create apps/api/prisma/seed.ts inserting >=6 realistic coffee-shop products (unique code, name, description, basePrice, category e.g. Coffee/Tea/Pastry, imageUrl, isAvailable, stockQuantity) via prisma.product.upsert keyed on code so it is idempotent. Seeding runs only against a live DB at runtime — NOT during build or tests.

Create CatalogModule: apps/api/src/catalog/catalog.module.ts; apps/api/src/catalog/products.service.ts with findAll() (prisma.product.findMany) and findOne(id) (prisma.product.findUnique; throw NotFoundException when null); apps/api/src/catalog/products.controller.ts with @Get() -> findAll and @Get(':id') -> findOne; apps/api/src/catalog/dto/product.dto.ts (response shape / params). Register CatalogModule in AppModule.

Add unit tests mocking PrismaService (no DB): apps/api/src/catalog/products.service.spec.ts (findAll returns the mocked product array; findOne returns a product; findOne throws NotFoundException/404 for a missing id) and apps/api/src/catalog/products.controller.spec.ts (controller delegates to service, GET /products/:id surfaces 404).
acceptance_criteria: `npm.cmd --workspace apps/api exec prisma generate` succeeds with NO database running.
`npm.cmd --workspace apps/api run build` succeeds (prisma generate + nest build) with no live DB.
`npm.cmd --workspace apps/api run test` passes all Jest tests with Prisma mocked (no live DB), covering list returns products and detail 404 on missing id.
`npm.cmd --workspace apps/api run lint` reports no errors.
Prisma Product model field names/types match docs/diagrams/class-domain.puml, and all other entities + enums are present in schema.prisma.
verification: Run `npm.cmd --workspace apps/api exec prisma generate` with no Postgres and confirm success.
Run `npm.cmd --workspace apps/api run build` and confirm exit 0.
Run `npm.cmd --workspace apps/api run test` and confirm all tests pass including the 404 case.
Run `npm.cmd --workspace apps/api run lint` and confirm no errors.
findings: Implemented apps/api NestJS 11 + Prisma 6 workspace. Pinned versions resolved from registry: @nestjs/* ^11.2.8, @nestjs/cli ^11, prisma/@prisma/client ^6.19.3, class-validator ^0.14.1, class-transformer ^0.5.1, ts-jest/jest ^29, typescript ^5.7.2, @typescript-eslint ^8, eslint ^8.57.1 (eslint 8 kept to stay on the legacy .eslintrc.js flat-config-free setup NestJS 11 scaffolds). Jest config lives inline in apps/api/package.json (ts-jest, rootDir src, testRegex .spec.ts). Prisma schema (apps/api/prisma/schema.prisma) models the FULL domain from class-domain.puml: enums Role/OrderStatus/PaymentStatus/PaymentMethod/PromotionType and models User, Product, Order, OrderItem, Payment, Promotion, LoyaltyTransaction with relations+multiplicities matching the diagram (User 1-0..* Order & LoyaltyTransaction; Order 1-1..* OrderItem; Product 1-0..* OrderItem; Order 1-0..1 Payment; Promotion 0..1-0..* Order; Order 0..1-0..1 LoyaltyTransaction). Product fields match the diagram exactly: id String @id @default(cuid()), code String @unique, name, description, basePrice Decimal, imageUrl, category, isAvailable Boolean @default(true), stockQuantity Int @default(0), createdAt DateTime @default(now()). Decided (not in plan, kept minimal): added a few nullable/@unique/@default qualifiers the diagram implies but does not spell out (User.phone optional, Order.idempotencyKey/code @unique, Payment.orderId @unique for the 0..1, LoyaltyTransaction.orderId @unique for the 0..1, OrderItem.selectedToppings String[]), so schema validates and relations are 1:1 where the diagram shows 0..1. CatalogModule: products.service.ts findAll (prisma.product.findMany) + findOne (findUnique, throws NotFoundException on null); products.controller.ts @Get() and @Get(':id'); dto/product.dto.ts response shape. PrismaModule is @Global, PrismaService extends PrismaClient with onModuleInit $connect / onModuleDestroy $disconnect. main.ts: PORT default 3001, CORS from CORS_ORIGIN default http://localhost:3000, global ValidationPipe({whitelist,transform}). Seed (prisma/seed.ts, wired via package.json#prisma.seed -> ts-node) upserts 8 coffee-shop products keyed on code (idempotent); excluded from tsconfig.build so nest build never needs it. Unit tests mock PrismaService/ProductsService (NO DB): products.service.spec (findAll returns mocked array, findOne returns product, findOne throws NotFoundException on missing id) and products.controller.spec (delegates to service, 404 surfaced). VERIFICATION (all exit 0, NO Postgres): `prisma generate` OK (client v6.19.3 generated to node_modules/@prisma/client), `npm.cmd --workspace apps/api run build` OK (prisma generate + nest build -> dist/main.js), `npm.cmd --workspace apps/api run test` 6/6 passed in 2 suites, `npm.cmd --workspace apps/api run lint` 0 errors; root `npm.cmd run test` fan-out also 6/6. GOTCHAS for FEAT-003/004: (1) PowerShell execute shell in this env buffers stdout and only flushes on the NEXT short command / fresh prompt, and a backgrounded `cmd /c "... &"` wedged the session once — avoid detached background npm; run foreground and poll via file markers / Test-Path or file_search. (2) npm install for this tree is slow/network-bound (took several minutes, reify order: @nestjs then @prisma); be patient, don't relaunch concurrent installs (they hold cache locks). (3) Prisma 6 warns package.json#prisma seed config is deprecated (removed in Prisma 7) and nags about the 8.0.0-rc upgrade — both are warnings, build still exits 0. (4) Decimal fields serialize as Prisma.Decimal; tests cast a string to Product['basePrice'] for the mock. DB-dependent steps (prisma migrate, seed) are runtime-only, never run in build/test/CI.
